data.title: 3,400 face the axe over exam fraud
data.description: More than 3,400 local-government officials face losing their jobs after authorities uncovered widespread score manipulation in a civil service examination, prompting the Interior Ministry to approve a new list of successful candidates.

data.title: More free trade deals to boost Thai exports
data.description: The government has pledged to leverage free trade agreements (FTAs) to help Thai businesses integrate into global supply chains, expand export markets and attract investment.

data.title: Meth treatment cost cut by herbal plan
data.description: A Thai herbal medicine programme could expand access to methamphetamine addiction treatment while reducing costs and improving recovery outcomes, according to a researcher at Thammasat University.

data.title: 4 Vietnamese held over scam network
data.description: Police arrested four Vietnamese nationals in Bangkok on Thursday after uncovering an alleged transnational network linked to call centre scams and drug trafficking.

data.title: Regional airport upgrade plan taking off
data.description: The government is betting on regional airports to drive Thailand's next wave of tourism and investment growth, with upgrades to facilities, flight routes and technology aimed at transforming them into economic gateways.

data.title: PM beefs up border controls
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered tighter border controls after Myanmar requested that Thailand block the flow of weapons to ethnic armed groups across the frontier.</p>

data.title: Phuket nominee companies face financial probe
data.description: The Interior Ministry has ordered a financial trail investigation into more than 100 Phuket companies suspected of being linked to foreign nominee networks, with combined revenue estimated at more than 5 billion baht last year.

data.title: Singapore PM to visit Thailand next month
data.description: Singapore's Prime Minister Lawrence Wong will visit Thailand next month for the first Singapore-Thailand Leaders' Retreat in more than a decade.

data.title: Slimming down the state
data.description: The government is attempting what many administrations before it have promised but ultimately failed to achieve: shrinking the country's sprawling bureaucracy.

data.title: PM Anutin sorry over P-Move clash
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has apologised following a clash between members of the People's Movement for a Just Society (P-Move) and volunteer defence personnel at the Interior Ministry on Thursday.</p>

data.title: Slowly, yet surely
data.description: In 2024, Tharinee Ratanasatien and Nawarat Welployngam joined an artist residency programme in the UK. Unlike their counterparts in Thailand, the creative professionals had access to structural support.

data.title: Hungarian masterpieces fit for a Queen
data.description: Under the Royal Patronage of HRH Princess Sirivannavari Nariratana Rajakanya, the Royal Bangkok Symphony Orchestra celebrated the birthday of HM Queen Suthida Bajrasudhabimalalakshana recently at the Thailand Cultural Centre, once again generously supported by B.Grimm and directed most expertly by resident conductor Dr Vanich Potavanich.

data.title: Oldest wild Sunda clouded leopard caught on camera
data.description: Newly-released camera trapfootage from a recentstudy captures the oldest wild Sunda clouded leopard ever recorded, an 8.5-year-old female in Malaysian Borneo's rainforests, offering a glimpse into the life of one of the world's most elusive wild cats.

data.title: More than The Mouse Boys
data.description: Malawi is not well known internationally for its traditional and popular music, although that may change with the release of a fascinating contemporary compilation Sounds Of Malawi Vol.1 (Hen House Studios).

data.title: Webs of interdependence
data.description: For some, a family guides how a person should feel and live in wider communities. In The Analects, Confucius' appreciation of ancestry is conveyed through the image of how a man continues to follow his father's way even after his death.

data.title: Howe exit leaves Magpies at crossroads
data.description: Of the many recent managerial changes in the Premier League, perhaps the biggest surprise was Eddie Howe stepping down at Newcastle United after a relatively successful five years as head coach. During that time the Magpies won their first trophy in many years and enjoyed several excursions into the Champions League.

data.title: Thammanoon returns to winning ways
data.description: The monthly CPF Boxing show staged by Petchyindee Promotions held its biggest event of the year in Bang Saen, Chon Buri, on Wednesday, with former two-division world champion Thammanoon Niyomtrong successfully returning to the winner's circle.

data.title: Gold hits seven-week high as US payrolls unexpectedly fall
data.description: Gold surged 2.3% as a surprise fall in US payrolls reduced expectations of a Federal Reserve rate rise and put bullion on course for a seven-month-best week

data.title: Appointment of former Yingluck aide questioned
data.description: Political activist Tul Sittisomwong has criticised the appointment of a former close aide to former prime minister Yingluck Shinawatra as director of the Strategic Transformation Office (STO).

data.title: War Elephants on brink of last four
data.description: Thailand need only a draw to confirm their place in the semi-finals of the Asean Hyundai Cup 2026 as they take on Myanmar in the last match of Group B at Rajamangala National Stadium on Saturday night.

data.title: Government weighs second phase of co-payment scheme
data.description: The government will review its fiscal position before deciding whether to proceed with the second phase of the "Thais Help Thais Plus" co-payment scheme or revise its conditions.

data.title: Tax breaks to lure carmakers
data.description: The Finance Ministry plans to introduce tax incentives by September to encourage foreign carmakers to establish production facilities in Thailand and increase the use of locally made components.

data.title: Embattled Fifa chief in Colombia for presidential inauguration
data.description: CALI, Colombia - Fifa president Gianni Infantino arrived on Friday in the Colombian city of Cali to attend hard-right president Abelardo de la Espriella's inauguration, as a crisis sweeps the highest echelons of the football world.

data.title: Flamboyant millionaire taking power in Colombia
data.description: CALI, Colombia - With a lucrative legal career and a variety of colorful business projects under his belt, Colombia's incoming president Abelardo de la Espriella now has grand plans to crush armed insurgents, cozy up to the United States and overhaul the system.

data.title: Spain imposes border checks on Italy as migrant showdown grows
data.description: MADRID - Spain announced on Friday it would introduce temporary border checks on travellers from Italy in response to Rome imposing similar measures after a mass migrant rush into Ceuta.

data.title: Trump's ex-lawyer all set for confirmation as US attorney general
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump's former personal lawyer Todd Blanche was set for confirmation Friday as US attorney general after Senate Republicans shrugged off Democratic concerns over politicization of the Justice Department.

data.title: Cambridge to review hiring process amid plagiarism row
data.description: LONDON - The University of Cambridge said Friday that it would be reviewing its hiring process for senior roles as it probes claims of plagiarism by a professor who resigned this week.

data.title: Central Retail to acquire MaxValu Thailand
data.description: Central Retail Corporation Plc (CRC) has agreed to acquire AEON (Thailand) Co Ltd, the operator of 30 MaxValu supermarkets in Thailand, in a move aimed at strengthening its food retail business and expanding the footprint of its Tops supermarket chain.

data.title: Bangkok heritage trail honours Queen Sirikit’s cultural legacy
data.description: Bangkok’s Rattanakosin heritage programme links museums, historic sites, Thai textiles and National Theatre performances in tribute to the late Queen Sirikit.
